t: You're standing in a garden near the Guildhall, marking the site of St Mary Aldermanbury. The church was destroyed in the Great Fire, rebuilt by Christopher Wren, then gutted in the Blitz in 1940, leaving only walls. In 1966 those stones were shipped to Fulton, Missouri, and rebuilt at Westminster College as part of the National Churchill Museum. Among those buried here were Henry Condell, the actor who helped prepare Shakespeare's First Folio; the astronomer Thomas Digges, who first explained the Copernican system in English; and Judge Jeffreys, nicknamed the Hanging Judge.
